headline: The new Battlefield 6 Season 5 battle pass includes rewards that look AI-made, among them a soldier skin with five identical handguns.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: a light gaming item resting on one outlet's reading of how items look.
importance_line: Players earning the battle pass rewards see items with visible mistakes and it adds to the debate over AI-made game art, but the AI claim rests on how the items look and the article quotes no confirmation from EA.
summary: MP1st reports that Season 5 of Electronic Arts' shooter Battlefield 6, released on 13 Oct 2026, has battle pass rewards that look AI-made, among them an operator (player character) skin with five identical handguns around it, a sleeve patch reading "Secuty" instead of "Security", and a weapon charm called "Drawing Dead" that a community member flagged. The piece's view that AI made the items is based on how they look, and it does not say that Electronic Arts has confirmed using AI.
notes: Read from fulltext. The release date follows from 'earlier today' in an article published 13 Oct 2026.
